overview_description.description:
Armilla AI is a governance platform that enables algorithmic accountability to drive ethical decisions with transparency.

The platform utilizes algorithmic accountability for tracking and governance and allows models to be tested in a matter of hours, vetting both the models themselves and the underlying datasets, helping clients by providing continuous monitoring of ongoing performance, accuracy, and algorithmic accountability by detecting errors.

product.name: Affirmative AI Liability Insurance
product.description: Standalone insurance coverage for liabilities arising from AI model errors, hallucinations, agent failures, data leakage, property damage, and AI-related regulatory actions.

product.name: AI Assessments and Independent Verification
product.description: Technical assessments that evaluate AI model performance, fairness, robustness, safety, vulnerabilities, and alignment with applicable regulations and industry standards.

product.name: AI Performance Warranty
product.description: A warranty linked to verified AI performance metrics that funds a customer remedy when an AI system falls below agreed performance thresholds.

identifier.value: AI Risk Monitoring and Incident Coordination

product.name: AI Risk Monitoring and Incident Coordination
product.description: Ongoing services for tracking AI model risks, regulatory changes, and incidents, with expert support for managing AI-related crises.

identifier.value: AI Litigation Database and Risk Hub

product.name: AI Litigation Database and Risk Hub
product.description: A portal-based resource that organizes AI litigation information to help organizations analyze liability trends, emerging exposures, and risk mitigation needs.

product.name: Broker AI Insurance Services
product.description: Broker enablement and placement services for Armilla’s AI insurance, including underwriting support, training, and resources for presenting coverage to clients.
